metadataRaw.title: How to Improve Hip Strength and Move With Less Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows exercises to strengthen your hips to make it easier to walk, use stairs, and move. 

Each exercise will focus on different muscles that are highly associated with hip pain and stiffness (including the glutes, hip flexors and rotators). By strengthening these muscles, we may get more pain-free range of motion.

To get the best results, go through them all and use what works best for you.

Watch now and improve your hip strength!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:47 Standing Exercise 1
3:30 Standing Exercise 2
6:38 Bed (or Floor) Exercise 1
9:50 Bed (or Floor) Exercise 2
